main_text.head: COLLATIO SPHAERAE rectæ ad obliquam.
main_text.p: HÆ Regulæ ad generalem consideratione̅m ascensionum & descensionum partium signiferi sufficiunt. Nunc ut tota res fiat illustrior, collatio- nem sphæræ rectæ & obliquæ instituemus, quæ & regulis aliquid lucis afferet, & de causis cogitan- dis lectorem admonebit. Dictum autem est supra, in omni sphæræ situ zodiacum ascendere inæqua- liter, propterea quòd circa alienos volvitur polos, ad quos aliæ ipsius partes accedunt propius, aliæ remouentur longius.
Ad eam causam etiam altera accedit, quæ ortus & occasus signiferi partium magis adhuc variat, nimirum obliquitas Horizontis, quæ efficit, ut cum anguli inclinationis ecliptice ad Horizontem plus

page.notes: Diagram letters (left sphere): Zenit, D, G, K, L, M, N, O, F, C, B. Right sphere: Zenit, B, F, E, A, M, O, N, C, D, G. The word "volvitur" is printed "uoluitur" in the scan: transcribed as printed "uoluitur"; "variat" has a doubtful letter. The last word of the page, "plus", sits alone at the right and is printed in larger type; it is the catchword-like line but continues the sentence, so it stays in the text. The second paragraph is set as a separate paragraph after an indent.
